technology.title: Technology: from waste to resources
technology.sub: The GMS plant is built around two process groups: sorting to separate material streams, and VPD technology to convert suitable feedstock into new products.
technology.overviewTitle: One stream in, six resource streams out
technology.diagramAria: Overview diagram: incoming waste splits into two branches. Sorting yields plastic film, organic humus and RDF. VPD technology yields syngas, activated carbon and recycled oil. The outputs return to a cycle of use.
technology.drawingTitle: 3D layout of the municipal solid waste sorting line
technology.drawingAlt: 3D engineering drawing of the municipal solid waste sorting line (with title block)
technology.drawingCaption: 3D engineering layout of the municipal solid waste sorting line (displayed with original title block as requested by GMS).
technology.vpdTitle: The conversion process, step by step
technology.vpdLead: Tap a step or choose “Auto play” to follow the feedstock through the line.

vpdSteps.title: Intake and storage
vpdSteps.desc: Incoming feedstock is gathered in a covered store before entering the line.

vpdSteps.title: Bag opening and loosening
vpdSteps.desc: Bags are opened and the mass is loosened so free water can drain off.

vpdSteps.title: Dewatering press
vpdSteps.desc: A press removes more of the remaining water.

vpdSteps.title: Drying
vpdSteps.desc: The material is dried in a recirculating dryer to suit the thermal stage.

vpdSteps.title: Thermal decomposition
vpdSteps.desc: In a closed chamber the material breaks down under heat; the remaining solids are collected separately.

vpdSteps.title: Gas cleaning and separation
vpdSteps.desc: The gas mixture is cooled, cleared of dust and split into separate streams.

vpdSteps.title: Gas drying and storage
vpdSteps.desc: Syngas is dried and sent to the product storage tank.

vpdSteps.title: Return loop
vpdSteps.desc: Part of the syngas is fed back to heat the decomposition chamber.

about.title: About GMS Hung Yen
about.lead: Hung Yen Green Energy Environment JSC (GMS Hung Yen) is a pioneer in municipal solid waste intake, mechanical sorting, and thermal resource conversion towards circular economy and sustainability.
about.visionDesc: To become the benchmark modern solid waste treatment facility in the Red River Delta, employing zero-smoke VPD pyrolysis technology and maximizing resource recovery.
about.missionDesc: Comprehensively solve local municipal waste challenges, minimize landfill usage, and transform waste into valuable fuel and clean energy.

solutions.title: Waste Treatment & Resource Recovery Solutions
solutions.lead: Comprehensive solutions spanning intake, mechanical sorting, vacuum pyrolysis conversion, and industrial supply partnerships.

items.title: 1. Integrated Mechanical Sorting
items.desc: Modern sorting line combining bag openers, trommel screens, magnetic separators, and optical sorting to accurately classify incoming waste streams.

items.title: 2. Zero-Smoke VPD Vacuum Pyrolysis
items.desc: Negative-pressure oxygen-deficient thermal decomposition preventing dark smoke and dioxins, recovering synthesis syngas and high-grade activated carbon.

items.title: 3. RDF Fuel Supply & Industrial Integration
items.desc: Producing calorific Refuse-Derived Fuel (RDF) pellets for industrial boilers and cement kilns to substitute fossil coal.

products.title: Six Output Product Lines from GMS Technology
products.lead: The synergy of mechanical sorting and VPD vacuum pyrolysis delivers six high-value product streams fueling the circular economy.

items.name: Recycled Plastic Film
items.desc: Separated clean plastic film stream from municipal solid waste supplied to plastic reprocessing plants.

items.name: Bio-Organic Humus
items.desc: Organic fraction screened by trommels and stabilized into nutrient-rich humus for soil conditioning.

items.name: Refuse-Derived Fuel (RDF)
items.desc: High-calorific pelletized fuel replacing fossil coal in industrial boilers and cement kilns.

items.name: Synthesis Gas (Syngas)
items.desc: Clean synthesis gas recovered from the VPD chamber, cooled and scrubbed for heat recirculation or power generation.

items.name: Activated Carbon / Biochar
items.desc: High-grade solid carbon recovered post-pyrolysis, applied in water purification, gas filtration, and soil remediation.

items.name: Recycled Pyrolysis Oil
items.desc: Condensed heavy and light oil fractions recovered during gas cleaning, serving as industrial fuel oil or refinery feedstock.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Common inquiries regarding process technology, environmental safety, and industrial partnership opportunities.

items.q: Does VPD vacuum pyrolysis produce dark smoke or dioxins/furans?
items.a: No. VPD operates in an oxygen-free negative-pressure sealed chamber at regulated temperatures without direct combustion, eliminating dark smoke and preventing dioxin/furan synthesis. Gases are rapidly quenched and multi-stage scrubbed.

items.q: What types of solid waste does the plant accept?
items.a: The plant accepts municipal solid waste from urban and rural districts, as well as non-hazardous industrial solid waste suitable for sorting and pyrolysis.

items.q: Where is the Refuse-Derived Fuel (RDF) utilized?
items.a: GMS RDF pellets feature high calorific value and low moisture, supplied to cement kilns, power plants, and industrial boilers to substitute fossil coal.

items.q: How can partners contact GMS for waste treatment or product off-take?
items.a: Partners can reach us directly via Hotline +84 98 799 83 70, official Zalo, or through the online inquiry form on our website.

privacy.title: Personal Data Processing & Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: Compliant with Vietnam Personal Data Protection Law No. 91/2025/QH15 and Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.
privacy.intro: Hung Yen Green Energy Environment JSC (GMS Hung Yen) is committed to safeguarding personal data and privacy rights of visitors, clients, and partners.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
sections.content: We only collect necessary personal details when you voluntarily submit an inquiry: Full Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Company/Organization Name, and message content.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of Data Processing
sections.content: Data is exclusively processed to respond to inquiries, provide technical support, and discuss collaboration. We strictly never sell or disclose your data to third parties for commercial gain.

sections.title: 3. Retention Period & Security Safeguards
sections.content: Data is encrypted in transit (SSL/TLS) and securely maintained on certified server infrastructure. Data is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill communication or until deletion is requested.

sections.title: 4. Data Subject Rights
sections.content: You retain full rights to inspect, rectify, withdraw consent, or request erasure of your personal data at any time by contacting: lienhe@gmshungyen.vn.
